_comment:
'**Ice Fusion** / If Glacial Footsteps was **fused**, it gains **dominate**.' Elemental Guardian Action - Attack (batch set label ArmoryDeckOriginsJarl; slug_index sets are ArmoryDeckOriginsJarl/OldhimBlitzDeck/TalesOfAria - pick the json/<set>/ folder from setIdentifiers at adoption).

NOT AUTHORED: Ice Fusion and Dominate are both printed keywords (printed_keywords) firing from the card DB keywords field. '<X> Fusion' is an optional additional cost at PLAY time (ability_keywords.fusion, ability_keywords.py:582-607 - read directly this session: a REVEAL from hand that writes the marker 'fused_<card.slug>' into the controller's current_turn_effects, :604-606); re-authoring either keyword wholesale would be a defect.

DOMINATE IS CONDITIONAL, SO THE MANDATED CONDITIONAL-KEYWORD SHAPE IS USED: the printed DB Dominate would otherwise apply unconditionally on every attack. loader.conditional_keywords() (loader.py:255-296, read this session) strips a printed keyword ONLY when an ability whose conditions include SOURCE_IS_ATTACK grants it via an UN-NESTED GAIN whose keyword is in _GRANTABLE_KEYWORDS (:243-246, dominate included) - this WHILE_STATIC is that ability (all three properties verified in source). engine._recalculate_attack_power then drops the printed copy from stage-6 keywords on every recalculation and this static re-grants it whenever its conditions hold; GAIN routes canonical_keyword('DOMINATE') -> 'Dominate' onto state.combat.keywords (effect_types.py:4927-4941, dedup-guarded), which is where the defend step enforces dominate - exactly the behaviour the official release notes describe (up to 1 card from hand, defense reactions from arsenal unaffected). SOURCE_IS_ATTACK (condition_types.py:381-387) is true exactly while THIS card is combat.attack_card, i.e. during Glacial Footsteps' own attack.

'WAS FUSED' GATE: FLAG_SET (condition_types.py:1032-1037) tests the marker fusion() writes, keyed per-printing - hence fused_glacial_footsteps_blue. Timing holds: fusion resolves as a play cost BEFORE the attack layer resolves, while ability-level conditions evaluate at each RECALC_ATTACK_POWER dispatch, so by then the flag is set or permanently absent.

UPSTREAM GAP, DISCLOSED LOUDLY (same finding .draft-review/flake_out_blue.json records for the identical text): the DB keyword is bare 'Fusion' (slug_index verified this session), so build_keyword_triggers computes supertype 'Fusion' (triggers.py:318-325, .replace(' fusion','') is a no-op) which matches NO card's types, fusion() returns False before the player is even asked (ability_keywords.py:587-590), and the marker is never written - the WHILE_STATIC re-grant can never fire, and because of this very ability loader.conditional_keywords() strips the printed DB Dominate, leaving NO dominate representation at all. The JSON shape is nonetheless the mandated pattern and needs no change; the fix is upstream (an element-bearing DB keyword e.g. 'Ice Fusion', or a fusion() fallback for bare 'Fusion'). Fails closed: unfused behaviour, which is every real game today.
